description: Make a link that opens QRvote’s create form already filled in: name, entries, questions or starter posts, rules, closing time, look. Give the link to the person: they check it and click Create (it needs a human check). Nothing is created until they do. To manage it afterwards, they can connect you at https://mcp.qrvote.org/mcp/organizer.

inputSchema.description: What to fill the create form with. Same shapes as the API (https://qrvote.org/openapi.json).

approve.description: qa, ideas, nominate, wall: new posts wait for the organizer's approval (default on, except ideas)

categories.description: Contests: separate awards, one vote in each (e.g. Scariest, Funniest)

closesAt.description: When voting ends, ISO 8601 with a time zone offset

entries.description: Contests and nominations: the entries (a nomination's suggestions join them); hunts: the checkpoints. A name, or { name, description }.

host.description: Quizzes: run it live on a big screen, one question at a time

kind.description: contest: people vote for entries; survey: questions; quiz: questions with right answers and a leaderboard; hunt: find QR checkpoints; qa: the audience asks and upvotes questions; ideas: people share and upvote ideas; nominate: people suggest the entries, then vote on the finalists; wall: people leave messages (no voting)

labels.description: ideas: categories people pick from (e.g. Went well, To improve, Try next)

lang.description: The voters' language: its QR codes, big screen and printed signs use it (anyone can still switch). Default: the language the person is using, else en.

mode.description: Contests: one vote in total, or one vote per entry (like/heart each)

names.description: qa, ideas, nominate, wall: people may add their name (default on, except ideas)

posts.description: qa, ideas, wall: starter posts, up from the start

questions.description: Surveys and quizzes, as in setQuestions: { type: single|multi|yesno|likert|rating|short|long, prompt, options? (single/multi), max? (rating 5 or 10), required?, answer? (quiz: option index, list of indexes, yesno 1/0, or accepted texts for short) }

name: draft_contest
title: Draft a new contest, survey, quiz, hunt, Q&A, ideas board, nomination or wall
